meta.title: Persona Context
meta.description: Context is everything the self has read (its own or external, from the session or from persona/memory). Its key property: read does not mean remembered — something can be in context and never enter memory.

tools.context_note: Record that something was read: source, kind, pointer, chars, own or external, and whether it entered memory.
tools.context_status: Show the context ledger: how many reads, by kind, and how many live only in context.
tools.context_check: Look a phrase up: is it in context, and did it enter memory.
tools.context_forget: Mark an entry as no longer counted in context; memory is untouched.
